title: iOS 1.12 — Current conditions on the cross-section
body:
- New Current conditions layer on the cross-section: turn it on to see the latest METAR at each airport and the active SIGMET zones along your route, updated live on flight day.
- Flight-day alerts now also flag thunderstorms, significant weather such as heavy snow, and strong wind at your departure, destination and alternates, and mark the matching airport row in Observations.
- If live tracking starts after your briefing was built, the changes panel now reads "Since live tracking began", so it's clear what it compares against.
- A SIGMET that spans several FIRs is now marked new in each one.
